South Korean university admission estimates

Published 2025 final-enrollee score centres, pooled across admission routes. Scores are percentile-like estimates of median enrollee ability.

University ability and route mix

Each bar's length follows reported seats; its colours show the admission paths that supply the estimate.

Overall estimate versus direct CSAT

A point joins the pooled university estimate to its direct regular-admission CSAT estimate. Labels mark the largest rank disagreements.

Circle area follows pooled reported seats. Direct-CSAT coverage differs sharply by university, so this chart does not treat the two estimates as interchangeable.

National route coverage

Green is capacity represented by a final-enrollee score; grey is the remaining 2027 planned capacity.

Program spread inside one university

Each dot is a program. Horizontal position is its median enrollee estimate and area follows represented seats.

School-record CSAT-floor audit

The y-axis takes the larger of the published student-record percentile and the program's CSAT-floor lower bound. Points on the diagonal did not move.
